# SLE Predictability & Alerts Requirements Checklist: 054 — Previsibilidade Dinâmica

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned quality checklist validating completeness, clarity, and consistency of requirements for dynamic SLE predictive alerts.  
**Created**: 2026-11-03  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness & Categorization

- [x] CHK001 Are distinct visual indicators and styling requirements defined for all four risk tiers (`normal`, `warning_p50`, `risk_p85`, `critical_p95`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are lifecycle exclusions explicitly specified so completed (`done`) and unstarted (`todo`) items do not display misleading in-progress alerts? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for displaying historical percentiles when the board has a custom team target configured? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are popover analytical contents (aging days, percentile ruler, breach delta) exhaustively enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Metric Quantifications

- [x] CHK005 Is the minimum historical sample size threshold quantified with an exact count (5 completed items) rather than subjective terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Is the mathematical definition of WIP Aging explicitly anchored to `startedAt` (with fallback to `createdAt`)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Are the popover hover delay and dismiss threshold quantified with specific millisecond durations? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK008 Are performance constraints quantified with exact latency targets (< 1ms calculation for 500 cards, < 3ms total)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## 3. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for zero-state and insufficient data scenarios (< 5 completed cards)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements specified for tasks that are simultaneously blocked and exceeding SLE thresholds? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements documented for tasks residing in buffer/waiting queue columns? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are defensive requirements defined for corrupt or future timestamps without throwing runtime errors? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 4. Non-Functional, Consistency & Brand Hygiene

- [x] CHK013 Are all statistical and flow concepts strictly expressed in canonical Lean/Kanban terminology with zero vendor brand leaks? [Consistency, Constitution §VII, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK014 Are storage requirements specified with explicit localStorage keys (`metrik_sle_config_${boardId}`) and defensive schema fallbacks? [Consistency, Constitution §VIII, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK015 Are modularity and file line count constraints defined to prevent any single module from exceeding 400 lines? [Non-Functional, Constitution §II, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK016 Are test automation requirements specified with deterministic, clock-independent mockable time anchors? [Testability, Constitution §III, Spec §SC-004]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK016) for easy reference and auditability.
